practical: Practical on Inverter, Transformer & Rectifier: Inspect internal components, verify cable terminations, identify switch positions, and test continuity. Safety: Wear PPE, ensure power isolation, verify zero voltage before touching terminals. Supervision: Instructor monitors safety compliance and component identification accuracy.
intro_questions: What is the primary function of a rectifier in an aircraft power system?
Define the role of a transformer in static converting equipment.
Why is an inverter required in modern avionics power distribution?

summary_questions: Explain the difference between a rotary inverter and a static inverter based on their mechanical components.
Describe the sequence of operation for an automatic change over system during a power failure.
Identify three critical safety precautions required when handling transformer rectifier units.
home_assignment_question: Prepare a brief note on the specific requirements for cable terminations on bus bars as discussed in LP 02, highlighting the importance of secure connections for avionics reliability.
